item.title: Night Market Event Pack

turns.text: Make a matching event pack: a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. Details on all three: Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. Warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold. Keep the reel text easy to read.

item.tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Lantern Night Market; 18 September 2027; 6–10 PM; Riverside Yard; Free entry. Include all five on every asset.
answer_sheet.Deliverables and dimensions: One 4:5 poster image, one 9:16 story image and one 9:16 reel.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm lantern imagery with midnight blue and gold; the three assets should visibly belong together.
answer_sheet.Music, voice and animation: Your call; no voiceover is needed.
answer_sheet.Additional copy or logo: No logo or additional event details are needed.

must_haves: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
The reel runs for 10 seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.

turns.text: Make a matching event pack: a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. Details on all three: Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. Warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold. Keep the reel text easy to read. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** The cheapest approach is to create one design, adapt it for the second format, then reuse the vertical image for the reel.

All three would share warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold, with:
> **Lantern Night Market**  
> 18 September 2027 · 6–10 PM  
> Riverside Yard · Free entry

### Cost options

| Option | Estimated credits | What you get |
|---|---:|---|
| **Lowest-cost matching pack** | **About 10** | One story image, one adapted 4:5 poster, and a **10-second static reel** holding the story image |
| Short animated pack | **About 130** | Both images plus a **5-second animated reel** |
| Requested animated pack | **About 250** | Both images plus a **10-second animated reel** |

**Basis:** free-compatible image generation/editing starts at 5 credits per image. The video-production workflow lists 24 credits per generated second at 480p. Making a video that simply holds an existing image uses no additional generation credits. These estimates exclude retries; I can’t verify your balance or a binding account-specific quote with the available tools.

### My recommendation
Choose the **~10-credit static pack**:
- **Poster:** 4:5, up to roughly 512 × 640.
- **Story:** 9:16, up to roughly 360 × 640.
- **Reel:** hold that story image for 10 seconds, keeping every detail readable throughout.

That is smaller and cheaper than animated video, and avoids moving-text distortion. Shortening the static reel would not reduce generation cost further. These small images are better suited to digital sharing than large-format printing.

**One important restriction:** Magic Hour’s workflow guide says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or another paid arrangement. If this promotes a commercial event, free-plan generation alone may not cover your intended use.

Would you like the **~10-credit static option**, or an animated option? Also, should the reel be **silent or have sound**? I’ll wait for approval before spending credits.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that. Sound is your call; no voiceover is needed.

dialog.agent:
I’ll use the low-cost static option and keep the reel silent—no voiceover or music generation.

The planning check requires one confirmation before spending credits: **Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?**

I have these five lines from your request, to appear on all three:
> Lantern Night Market  
> 18 September 2027  
> 6–10 PM  
> Riverside Yard  
> Free entry

You can simply reply **“Yes, those exact words.”**
dialog.user: Yes, those exact words on all three. ok, go ahead with that

turns.agent:
The account refused the first image generation due to **insufficient credits**. The tool reports that nothing was created, so I stopped—no poster, story or reel has been generated, and no generation credits were spent.

The earlier **~10-credit total was an estimate**, not a verified account quote. I can’t check your remaining balance with the available tools.

A no-generation alternative is to build the midnight-blue-and-gold design in a free layout editor, export it at **4:5** and **9:16**, then hold the vertical image for **10 seconds** as a silent reel. That avoids Magic Hour generation credits entirely.
